page_note: No cosmological substrate present. The entire page is occupied by Manichaean ecclesial Q&A about catechumens, almsgiving offerings to the elect, and whether such offerings inflict 'a stripe and a blow' upon the living soul. Page-level teaching purity is 0.000. Two chapter-units of apostolic dialogue: catechumens asking the apostle (ⲡⲁⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ) about ritual practice and timing of offerings. The closing simile of two men and an enemy (segs 28-33) is a pastoral analogy in service of the ecclesial answer, not cosmic-correspondential mapping. Editorial fatigue score shows ecclesial vocabulary very heavy in first half (36.1) decreasing in second half as the apostle pivots into hortatory address (+7.1). Heavy damage (55.9%) further obscures the material but no substratic teaching is recoverable.
